caption: Performance of different triggers. The words used as triggers on the horizontal axis are arranged in ascending order according to the ASR of the clean model.
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the performance of different trigger words in terms of Attack Success Rate (ASR), with the trigger words arranged along the horizontal axis in ascending order of their ASR on the clean model. The vertical axis represents the ASR, ranging from 0.5 to 1.0. Three distinct trigger types are plotted: 'start' (teal line with circle markers), 'random' (orange line with 'x' markers), and 'end' (purple line with circle markers). The 'start' trigger shows a generally increasing trend, starting at an ASR of approximately 0.77 for 'cf', rising to a peak of 0.93 at 'Estadio', and then decreasing to 0.83 for 'athletics'. The 'random' trigger exhibits a more volatile pattern, starting at an ASR of 0.51 for 'cf', peaking at 0.93 at 'WNBA', then dropping to 0.65 at 'ESPN', rising again to 0.85 at 'Estadio', and finally settling at 0.78 for 'athletics'. The 'end' trigger starts at an ASR of 0.62 for 'cf', drops to 0.59 for 'bb', spikes to a maximum of 0.95 at 'WNBA', then declines to 0.75 at 'ESPN', increases to 0.82 at 'NHL', dips to 0.79 at 'FIFA', peaks again at 0.92 at 'Estadio', and ends at 0.83 for 'athletics'.
